name: 63090 · Washington, MO
findings: ZIP 63090 (Washington) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63090 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63090 (Washington) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
